title: RS5M and GeoRSCLIP: A Large Scale Vision-Language Dataset and A Large Vision-Language Model for Remote Sensing

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the geolocation distribution of dataset images across Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) zones to identify regional overrepresentation (e.g., North America, Europe) and underrepresentation (e.g., Middle Africa, underdeveloped areas).
